non_english: Mein herr, that is very nearly the whole of my German, and now we must go on in English.
Guten tag -- there, I have spent my German and must fall back on English.
Ach so! But you will have to put the rest to me in English, I am afraid.
Nicht wahr? You see I have a word or two, and no more than a word or two.
I have a little German, mein herr, but you go too fast for me.
Danke -- and now, if you please, in English, for my sake.
